subject: Post-demo: privacy & telemetry checklist / vendor SQ initiation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Brian Lee <brian.lee@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:08:00 -0000
Subject: Post-demo: privacy & telemetry checklist / vendor SQ initiation

Brian — thanks again for a productive demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the security/compliance items your team asked about: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II is in flight. Can you confirm expected delivery date and whether you can share an interim SOC 2 readiness summary or third-party attestation? We can accept a SOC 2 letter or a sealed report when available.

2) HIPAA scope: please confirm whether PHI will ever be submitted to the Redwood service for this project. If yes, we’ll prioritize HIPAA-specific controls and DPA language.

3) Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ): I’m attaching our standard VSQ (vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf) — can your security team complete and return by end of next week? If it’s easier, we can do a short bridge call for any technical questions.

4) Console + Docs telemetry / cookie tracking: you asked for detail on what telemetry we collect in the customer console vs what the public docs site collects. Specifically, it would help for us to know whether your compliance review needs a listing of: 
   - cookies set on docs.redwood.com (marketing/analytics / third-party trackers),
   - cookies/local storage used by the customer console (session tokens, preferences, optional telemetry), and
   - any product-level telemetry that’s sent back to Redwood for performance/usage (and whether you need anonymized samples).

Action items proposed:
- Brian / security@acmeinc.com: confirm SOC 2 timing + whether HIPAA applies (reply)
- Security: complete VSQ (pdf attached) or propose a 30-min follow-up call (I’ll coordinate)
- Jordan/Redwood: provide cookie inventory template and DPA draft for review

I’ve cc’d Marissa (enterprise security lead) and Karthik (solutions/security engineer) to help coordinate the VSQ and technical deep dive. If the dates below work for you I’ll send calendar invites: Wednesday 6/23 10:00am PT or Thursday 6/24 2:00pm PT for a 45-minute session with Karthik.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Brian Lee <brian.lee@acmeinc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmeinc.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: privacy & telemetry checklist / vendor SQ initiation

Jordan — thanks for the recap and for pulling this together. A few quick responses: 

- SOC 2: we are currently finishing our Type II run; expected completion date is ~2027-07-15. We can share a readiness summary and the Type II report once finalized. In the meantime, I’ve attached a short summary with our current control posture (acme_security_answers.pdf).

- HIPAA: at this stage PHI will not be routed to the vendor platform for this initial integration; that said we may revisit for specific healthcare workloads later. We’ll flag if that changes.

- Vendor SQ: I’ll have our security analyst start on your VSQ. Can you confirm preferred format? We can upload a redlined PDF or populate a spreadsheet template. Also, can you provide a short guidance doc that shows the fields you most commonly need filled?

- Cookies/Telemetry: high-level - our compliance team will want flat list of cookies on docs vs console, plus which ones are first vs third party and whether any user identifiers are persisted. For product telemetry, if you can point to a sample event schema (pseudonymized) that helps.

Suggested next step: confirm the 6/23 10am PT slot for a technical review with Karthik — that works for me and I’ll add security@acmeinc.com.

I’ve attached the initial summary and our internal contact info for the VSQ.

Best,
Brian

Attachment: acme_security_answers.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Brian Lee <brian.lee@acmeinc.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: privacy & telemetry checklist / vendor SQ initiation

Brian — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few notes from the Redwood side and an internal checklist so we don’t miss anything in the VSQ/technical review: 

Redwood items for ACME:
- I will share a DPA draft (redwood_dpa_draft.pdf) for initial review; it contains our standard data processing terms + HIPAA addendum placeholder.
- Jordan will provide a cookie inventory template (attached) and a short guidance doc for completing the VSQ fields.
- We can provide a pseudo-sample of product telemetry events and a short description of retention windows (configurable per account).

Internal action items (Redwood):
- Karthik to lead the 6/23 technical deep dive (console telemetry, auth flows, cookie scopes, sample events). Karthik — please prepare: auth cookie/session lifetime, what’s stored client-side vs server-side, and the list of optional telemetry flags (opt-in/out).
- Security: prepare SOC 2 evidence list and expected delivery cadence to share with ACME once their SOC 2 is available.

Guidance for ACME VSQ completion: we prefer either the redwood cookie_inventory_template.csv (attached) or a populated PDF. The key columns we use are: cookie_name, domain, first_party/third_party, purpose, persistence (session/30d/365d), pii_flag (yes/no), and notes.

If ACME would like, we can do a 20-minute pre-call with your security analyst to walk the questionnaire fields before they start filling it out.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Lead, Enterprise Security Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_dpa_draft.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: privacy & telemetry checklist / vendor SQ initiation

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick confirmation of next steps and what I’m sending right now: 

- Meeting: I’ve scheduled the technical deep dive for Wed 2027-06-23 10:00am PT. Invite sent to Brian and security@acmeinc.com. Karthik, please hold that slot.

- Attachments I’m dropping into the HubSpot deal and sending separately here: cookie_inventory_template.csv (CSV template for cookies), vendor_sq_completion_guidance.docx (short instructions + preferred return format). I’ll also share our DPA draft in the portal for legal review.

- Brian: please try to return the VSQ by 2027-06-25 if possible; if you need the pre-call with our security analyst, let us know preferred times on Monday/Tuesday next week.

Linking resources: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/ACME-2027-4987; placeholder SOC 2 timeline doc — https://redwood.aws.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/soc2-acknowledgement-placeholder.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up after the 6/23 call with a consolidated evidence checklist for your procurement team.
